reason: The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands in primitive P2_1/n (No. 14; conventional standardization P2_1/c is the same structure) to 20 fully occupied, ordered atoms, Li2Bi2B4O12 = 2 LiBi(BO3)2, with the stated 8.04271 x 5.98647 x 4.62075 A monoclinic cell, beta = 92.75475 degrees, and Z = 2. Indexing is strong (M(20) = 89.9, F(20) = 128.8; 36-49 lines refine at about 0.004-0.008 degrees RMS), and no important observed peak is unindexed. The trace contains instantiated integrated-intensity and whole-profile coordinate refinements, not position-only matching; an independent fixed-CIF profile check using the declared Uiso = 0.010 A^2 gives R about 5.63%, close to a flexible independent-intensity profile floor of about 4.79%, with the excess residual comparable to the measured noise. Direct-space searches converge on the same BO3 framework, and the selected Li ordering fits better than the other inversion-site choices while those alternatives also produce 1.62 or 1.44 A Li-O contacts. The submitted model has no overlaps, trigonal BO3 groups at 1.389-1.391 A, complete six-contact Bi-O and Li-O shells, charge-balanced Li(I)/Bi(V)/B(III)/O(-II), and bond-valence-consistent assignments. No concrete incompatible symmetry, ordering, occupancy, superstructure, or framework branch survives.
